conservation.technical_description: Overall the condition is good.  Minor inherent abrasions to overall surface with bare canvas visible in areas.  Abrasions dominate right side of canvas and lower left quadrant.  Indentions in canvas at URC, ULC, LRC.  Cleavage with missing flake at LLC.  Brown accretion in lower left quadrant.
